description:
[read-only] The brand's Meta custom and lookalike audiences (id, name, type, preset, size) and the owner's audience limits (presets on, most included / excluded per ad set, lookalike ratio range, customer-list batch size). Put the ids in includeAudienceIds / excludeAudienceIds of ads_campaign_create, or use one as seedAudienceId of a lookalike.
(Wraps GET /api/v2/ads/audiences.)

brandId.description: A brand id (GET /api/v2/brands) or "personal"; default: the key owner's active brand.

name: ads_audiences_list
title: List custom and lookalike audiences
